home.title: SOLAR SYSTEMS AI
home.subtitle: PLATFORM
home.description: Infrastructure that disappears — so people get their hours back. The governed control plane for taking AI agents into production: every task carries proven identity, executable authorization policy and a tamper-evident audit trail, inside an architecture of virtual punch cards.

why.headline: WHY_WE_BUILD
why.problem_text: Modern knowledge workers lose hours daily to tasks that don't require human judgment. Manual data processing, queue triage, workflow navigation — time stolen from creativity, relationships, and presence.
why.insight_text: People aren't depleted because they lack tools. They're depleted because their tools demand constant attention. The best infrastructure is the kind you stop noticing.
why.enterprise_text: Agents reached production. Governance did not. Building the prototype is the easy part; what separates it from corporate operation is a wall of requirements nobody demos.

enterprise_gaps.title: IDENTITY_THAT_GETS_LOST
enterprise_gaps.text: The agent acts 'on behalf of' someone — but who authorized what dissolves between hops. Responsibility cannot be proven after the fact.

enterprise_gaps.title: PERMISSION_BY_CONVENTION
enterprise_gaps.text: Access to data and tools is governed by prompt and good will, not by policy a machine can evaluate and deny.

enterprise_gaps.title: AUDIT_THAT_DOES_NOT_HOLD
enterprise_gaps.text: Editable logs answer neither auditor nor regulator: what did this agent do, under what authority, over which data?

why.valley_text: This is where pilots die — not for lack of intelligence, but for lack of control. They impress in the demo and then meet security, compliance and risk. What is missing is the layer that turns 'a demo that works' into 'a system the audit approves'.
why.answer_text: Solar Systems AI removes the non-human work — with accountability, auditability, and bounds. The same architecture that gives people their hours back is the one that makes an agent defensible in a regulated environment: infrastructure that disappears, and answers when asked.

how.flow_intro: Solar Systems sits between the caller and the models. A task crosses identity, policy and audit before it touches any data.

flow_steps.name: VENUS
flow_steps.text: The single door in — including internal callers. Derives who is calling from the token; never trusts the request body.

flow_steps.name: SUN
flow_steps.text: Profiles the task and puts it through a security gate — classifier plus policy — before any execution is provisioned.

flow_steps.name: MARS + GDWG
flow_steps.text: Launches agents on-behalf of the real principal, in isolated containers. GDWG drives autonomous loops over a governed graph.

flow_steps.name: NEPTUNE
flow_steps.text: One way to run inference for the whole platform — routed across external providers and local models, by measured merit.

how.execution_note: AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION — GDWG drives agent loops over a governed graph, under the same identity, authorization, quota and audit as every other planet. Harness-agnostic: three harnesses — Claude Code, Codex and Cursor — each drove the engine over the real MCP wire, each with its own model, in an isolated tenant, and the graph closed the contract identically (3/3, 2026-06-11). This is the HARNESS axis: the contract closes the same under external authorship. It is not a claim about the execution or efficacy of the code produced.

principles.headline: GOVERNANCE_BY_CONSTRUCTION
principles.subtitle: Guarantees by construction — properties of the architecture, not checklists someone must remember to run.

guarantees.title: IDENTITY_PER_HOP
guarantees.tagline: Identity is derived at every hop — never read from the request body.
guarantees.description: Venus derives the caller from the token; child agents act on-behalf of the real principal through a session mint issued by the security plane. 'On whose behalf' travels as a signed token, not as a field someone can declare.

guarantees.title: EXECUTABLE_POLICY
guarantees.tagline: Authorization is executable, closed-world policy (OpenFGA): no explicit grant, no access.
guarantees.description: Access is a relation in an authorization model, not a convention in a prompt. Capability grants are per tenant, checked on each sensitive call, and the check is auditable after the fact.

guarantees.title: TAMPER_EVIDENT_AUDIT
guarantees.tagline: Tamper-evident audit trail — what, who, under what authority, over which data.
guarantees.description: Audit records are hash-chained in the Moon, written under a per-tenant write-time lock, with write scope restricted. Chaining gives evidence of tampering without the cost of distributed consensus.

guarantees.title: MULTI_TENANT_ISOLATION
guarantees.tagline: Tenant, quota and budget scoped per principal (Saturn).
guarantees.description: Tenants are first-class: principals, roles, capability plans, quota and budget live behind one owner, and reads resolve the tenant from the token rather than trusting a query parameter.

guarantees.title: NO_LOCK_IN
guarantees.tagline: Model and agent are pluggable — harness-agnostic via MCP.
guarantees.description: Inference routes through a single gateway across external providers and local models. The governance contract holds identically for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: the method and the graph are the asset, not the vendor.

guarantees.title: BOUNDED_EFFORT
guarantees.tagline: Every task declares its cost before running.
guarantees.description: No runaway processes, no surprise bills. Every execution has a pre-declared budget for time, resources, and operations. If the budget is exceeded, the task is safely terminated.

status.headline: STATUS
status.subtitle: Verified engineering milestones. Each one measured live, on the date shown.

milestones.message: AUDIT_WRITE_LOCK — Per-tenant write-time lock on the audit hash-chain switched on; live gate 3/3
JUDGMENT_CORPUS_PROVENANCE — Shadow judgment stops injecting fabricated attribute values; every attribute is real, curated or unknown
SUBMISSION_PERIMETER — A caller that merely declares itself internal no longer skips the security classifier; declared-but-unproven identity is stripped
MASTER_CREDENTIAL_REMOVED — The full-bypass admin token is dead; every admin authorization now goes through per-user RBAC (FGA). Old token → 401, session token → 200
FAIL_CLOSED_CONVERSION — Six security gates converted from fail-open to fail-closed, each dated and committed (2026-07-13 → 2026-08-01)
SECRET_RESOLUTION_GATED — The secret-resolution endpoint stops answering without a credential: no bearer → 401
SESSION_KEY_DURABILITY — The session signing key moves to the vault; a restart no longer invalidates every live session
TENANT_FROM_TOKEN — Open read surfaces now require a credential and resolve the tenant from the token, not from a query parameter
FEDERATED_LOGIN — Human login federated through OIDC (Keycloak); the platform never stores a password
HARNESS_AGNOSTICISM — The governance contract closed identically under Claude Code, Codex and Cursor over the real MCP wire (3/3)

status.evidence_note: EVIDENCE: each milestone is recorded in the platform's enforcement ledger with its flag, failure posture and decision record.

about.headline: ABOUT
about.positioning: Solar Systems AI is built on the conviction that intelligent infrastructure should serve human ends — not demand human attention. We build systems that disappear from notice, freeing people for what matters most.
about.approach: Every architectural decision reflects our belief that automation must be bounded, accountable, and in service of human presence. This is not 'AI everywhere' — this is AI precisely where it belongs.
